properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 29 at 7:12PM MDT until July 29 at 8:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
SVRPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Central Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

* Until 800 PM MDT.

* At 712 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 14 miles south of
Pueblo Reservoir, or 15 miles southwest of Pueblo, moving east at
20 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* This severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly rural areas of
central Pueblo County.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 29 at 7:07PM MDT until July 29 at 10:00PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Aspen Acres burn scar in...
East Central Custer County in southeastern Colorado...
West Central Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

* Until 1000 PM MDT.

* At 707 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Aspen Acres Burn Scar. Between 1 and 2 inches
of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1.5 to 3 inches
in 1 hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.
Excessive rainfall over the burn scar will result in debris flow.
The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and other
loose materials.

FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY for The northern and central part of the
Aspen burn scar, including Beulah. This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS
SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER GROUND NOW!

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Aspen Acres Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...This is a PARTICULARLY DANGEROUS SITUATION. SEEK HIGHER
GROUND NOW! IMMEDIATE EVACUATION for areas in and around
the Aspen Acres Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Beulah, San Isabel and Wetmore.

This includes the following high risk locations...
Beulah Water Intake, Northcreek Road county line to Red Mountain Camp
and Northcreek Road from Red Mountain Camp to Beulah.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 29 at 7:07PM MDT until July 29 at 7:15PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
The Flood Advisory will expire at 715 PM MDT this evening for a
portion of southwest Colorado, including the following area,
Hinsdale.

Excess runoff from heavy rain has ended over the advised area
including Lake City and Slumgullion Pass. If flooding has been
observed...Please report it to your local law enforcement agency.
Arroyo and small stream flooding is no longer expected to pose a
threat. Please continue to heed remaining road closures.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 29 at 6:44PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
At 644 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 23
miles northwest of Fruita, or 32 miles northwest of Grand Junction,
moving northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

This storm will remain over mainly rural areas of southwestern
Garfield, southwestern Rio Blanco and northeastern Grand Counties.

This includes Colorado 139 between mile markers 12 and 46.
properties.areaDesc: Lower Yampa River Basin; Roan and Tavaputs Plateaus; Grand Valley; Tavaputs Plateau; Arches/Grand Flat

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 29 at 6:43PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 642 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Walsenburg, or 38 miles south of Pueblo. This thunderstorm was nearly
stationary.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and nickel size hail and torrential
rainfall.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible. Heavy rainfall could cause ponding of water on
paved road surfaces, washouts on dirt roads, and quick
runoff causing high flows in area creeks, streams and
normally dry washouts.

Locations impacted include...
Walsenburg.
